# Extuse Me (extuse_me) — Cinema, Film Edits, Memes & Creative Portfolio

> Extuse Me is a premier Indian cinema, video editing, and meme marketing brand created by Sarath. Founded in 2021, Extuse Me produces cinematic movie cuts, viral meme campaigns, promotional edits, and offers free video editing assets (Google Drive templates, fonts, overlay materials).

## Creator Profile & Summary
- **Brand Name**: Extuse Me (extuse_me)
- **Creator**: Sarath (Sarath-tp)
- **Established**: 2021
- **Focus Areas**: Malayalam Cinema, Tamil Cinema, Indian Movies, Video Editing, Meme Marketing, Creative Direction, Film Cuts, Audio Edits
- **Network Reach**: Strong promotion network of **100+ FX pages** and **60+ troll/meme pages** across Kerala for high-visibility film promotions & client campaigns.
- **Website**: https://sarath-tp.github.io/Extuse-me/
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/extuse_me
- **YouTube**: https://youtube.com/@talesoftintu
- **Telegram**: https://t.me/Tintujc
